data.heading: Creative Slide Choreography
data.subtitle: Unlocking modern asymmetric layouts, interactive timelines, stepper journeys, and responsive quizzes.
data.speakerNotes: Welcome! Today we showcase how different slide structures choreograph an engaging presentation flow.

data.heading: The 3-Step Choreography Process

steps.title: 1. Layout Wireframing
steps.content: Structure your core story blocks first. Map content hierarchies using standard Bento grids and grids to avoid visual fatigue.
steps.tip: Keep blocks focused on one single primary takeaway per card.

steps.title: 2. OKLCH Color Harmonization
steps.content: Configure custom OKLCH tokens to support instant light and dark mode adaptations with identical perceptual lightness.
steps.tip: Use color-mix for transparent glowing glass borders.

steps.title: 3. Visual Interactivity Hook
steps.content: Convert static lists to click-to-flip cards, expand-on-click bullets, or interactive quiz nodes to hook your students.
steps.tip: Animations should never exceed 300ms to maintain snappy responses.

data.speakerNotes: Show students the Stepper block. Guide them step-by-step through the presentation blueprint process.

data.heading: PowerPoint vs. Next-Gen Storytelling
data.verdict: Visual and interactive storytelling delivers 3.5x higher knowledge retention in modern classrooms.
data.speakerNotes: Discuss the contrast. Emphasize why moving away from traditional bullet walls boosts engagement.

data.heading: High-End UX Core Features

items.title: Ultra-Responsive Layouts
items.content: Grid blocks fluidly stack and adapt depending on device viewport or speaker orientation. Premium UI designed from the ground up to feel like a high-end web app.

items.title: Wide Gamut OKLCH
items.content: Luminous colors that render accurately without standard RGB pixel clipping.

items.title: Zero Dependencies
items.content: Built with pure vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS. Fast load time guaranteed.

data.speakerNotes: Highlight the Bento grid template. Show how small features surround the large visual card.

data.heading: Aesthetic Intelligence Check

questions.question: What is the primary advantage of designing with the OKLCH color space over standard HSL?
options: It supports more standard RGB colors.
It keeps perceptual lightness consistent across different hues.
It is supported by older browsers without polyfills.
It makes HTML pages render 50% faster.
questions.explanation: Consistent perceptual lightness is the superpower of OKLCH. When you swap colors from green to yellow, the brightness feels identical to the human eye, maintaining perfect contrast!

data.speakerNotes: Engage the audience with this interactive quiz. Click option B to reveal the explanation.

data.heading: Evolution of Interactive Web Media

events.title: The Adobe Flash Era
events.description: Heavy plugins, closed ecosystems, and insecure binaries. The web graphics landscape was fragmented and slow.

events.title: The Flexbox & Framework Rise
events.description: CSS Flexbox and grids became standard. React, Vue, and heavy npm libraries dominated presentation frameworks.

events.title: Vanilla Glassmorphism & OKLCH
events.description: Wide-gamut colors, native container queries, and direct zero-dependency static builds. Snappy, beautiful, and completely offline-ready.

data.speakerNotes: Showcase the timeline progression. Walk the class from 2010 plugins up to the premium 2026 native standards.
